work.title: Hand Raised Warplane
work.description: Collage combining a painted hand gesture with a side-view warplane cutout over iridescent foil, blue brushwork, and layered black-and-orange paper fragments. Central figural element is rendered in ink on flesh-toned paper, topped by an orange diamond shape against silver-foil and black torn forms.
work.composition: vertical split between iridescent and figural zones
